Measures.MeasureSummary: Measures regulating the kind, colour and size of printing on packages and  labels and defining the information that should be provided to the consumer. Labelling is any written, electronic, or graphic communication on the packaging or on a separate but associated label, or on the product itself. It may include requirements concerning the official language to be used, as well as technical information on the product, such as voltage, components, instructions on use, and safety and security advice.

Measures.MeasureTitle: Distribution and location of products after delivery
Measures.MeasureSummary: Requirements relating to the disclosure of information on when and/ or how the products have been distributed during any time after production and before final consumption. This measure includes recordkeeping requirements.

Measures.MeasureTitle: Requirement to pass through specified port of customs
Measures.MeasureSummary: Obligation for imports to pass through a designated entry point and/or customs office for inspection, testing and the like.

Measures.MeasureTitle: Prohibition for the protection of environment
Measures.MeasureSummary: Prohibition of imports for the protection of the environment.

Labelling is any written, electronic, or graphic communication on the packaging or on a separate but associated label, or on the product itself. AllMeasures.LegislationTitle: Notification of the Committee on Labels No.11(B.E.2545) Re: Toothbrushes to be labelling controlled
AllMeasures.LegislationSummary: Item 3 The Regulation requires the labelling of toothbrush to be sold in Thailand contain the following information:  1. Characteristic of toothbrush  2. Type of toothbrush  3. Material  4. Instruction  5. Suggestion  6. Range of age that the product suits for
AllMeasures.ImplementationAuthority: Online Office of The Consumer Protection Board

AllMeasures.Title: Labelling requirements
AllMeasures.Summary: Measures regulating the kind, colour and size of printing on packages and  labels and defining the information that should be provided to the consumer. Labelling is any written, electronic, or graphic communication on the packaging or on a separate but associated label, or on the product itself. It may include requirements concerning the official language to be used, as well as technical information on the product, such as voltage, components, instructions on use, and safety and security advice.
AllMeasures.Comment: To protect consumers' right and keep consumers away from harm
AllMeasures.LegislationTitle: Notification of Label Committee (No. 38) B.E. 2559 Re: Define the electric mosquito beater to be a product with regulatory label
AllMeasures.LegislationSummary: Item 2 Define the electric mosquito beater to be a product with regulatory label.  Item 3 The label of the product with regulatory label in Item 2 has to follow item 1 – 3 in Notification of Label Committee Re: The label of the product with regulatory label B.E. 2541 and add these detail to the label.  (1) An instruction must include “Cleaning should be done with dried blush and avoid water cleaning.”  (2) An warning must include “Keep away from kids and charging away from flammable substance.” attached permanently in visible position.  Notification of Label Committee Re: The label of the product with regulatory label B.E. 2541  [Item 2 Label of controlled product have to show  (1) Name or type of product that represent what it is. If it is imported product for sale, there has to be the exporting country on the label.  (2) Name or trademark of producer which is registered in Thailand  (3) Name or trademark of importer which is registered in Thailand]
AllMeasures.ImplementationAuthority: Office of the Consumer Protection Board

AllMeasures.Title: Distribution and location of products after delivery
AllMeasures.Summary: Requirements relating to the disclosure of information on when and/ or how the products have been distributed during any time after production and before final consumption. This measure includes recordkeeping requirements.
AllMeasures.Comment: Distribution and location of products after delivery
AllMeasures.LegislationTitle: Ministry of Industry's notice on fact reporting by manufacturer, importer, exporter or possessor of hazardous substances to Department of Industrial Works (No.2) B.E. 2563
AllMeasures.LegislationSummary: Importer of hazardous substance is required to submit to a competent official accounts regarding the volume of each hazardous substance that is imported, sold and remaining in stock as well as the name of buyers.
AllMeasures.AdditionalCommentProduct: Hazardous substances additionally specified in the regulation
